description: This file defines a class 'RelationalStorageProviderQueries' that encapsulates SQL query clauses used by the Orleans AdoNet grain storage system. It provides properties for write, read, and clear storage operations, with a constructor that enforces non-null arguments.

classes.name: RelationalStorageProviderQueries
